answer: Proof-of-burn entry resists sybils by forcing every new agent to irreversibly destroy tokens before it can act. One identity costs little, but minting a thousand fakes multiplies that burn into a wall as unyielding as basalt. Honest agents treat the network as a haven worth the toll, while an attacker flooding it finds the ground as barren as frozen tundra: each burned coin is gone for good, the forged crowd earns nothing back, and the sybil swarm bankrupts itself before it can sway a single vote.
